title: MINIDUMP's Memory64 data is stored continuously in descriptor order.
summary: BaseRva of MINIDUMP_MEMORY64_LIST points to the first raw bytes. The positions of subsequent segments are accumulated from the DataSize of previous segments.
applies: Windows MINIDUMP; static interpretation of acquired dump
detail: Each descriptor also records the runtime starting address; to locate a byte in this range, its offset relative to the beginning of the segment is also added.
boundary: Virtual address ranges may not be contiguous with each other. Do not regard the difference between adjacent virtual addresses directly as the interval between two segments in the file.
relevance: Map a memory range in the dump to real file bytes.
